links.outcome: Translation accuracy by language (fluency, adequacy, meaning, severity) versus professional interpreters
links.effect: Machine translation non-inferior for adequacy, meaning, severity in Spanish and Portuguese and all four domains in Chinese; fluency inferior in Spanish and Portuguese. Clinically significant error frequency did not differ by method.
links.quote: For fluency, Google Translate and ChatGPT-4o were inferior in Spanish and Portuguese but non-inferior in Chinese.

unlisted_practices: Using machine translation (Google Translate or ChatGPT-4o) for ED discharge instructions for patients with limited English proficiency compared with professional interpreters

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the translation accuracy and safety (clinically significant errors) of LLMs (ChatGPT-4o) and Google Translate on real ED discharge instructions compared to professional interpreters.
